_meta.tier: canonical (Tier 2) — the real, expert-labeled cases. THE company asset.
_meta.how_to_build: Replace every EXAMPLE below with REAL cases sourced from r/saudiarabia, r/interiordecorating, Quora, Facebook groups, or user interviews. Collecting these IS problem-validation and benchmark-seeding in one motion.
_meta.why_not_exact_match: Furniture has no single correct answer (unlike MMLU). So a case is NOT graded output==expected. It is graded against (a) objective hard_constraints and (b) an expert soft rubric.
_meta.scoring: case_score = hard_pass ? (0.6 * criteria_met_fraction + 0.4 * expert_stars/5) : 0. benchmark_score = mean(case_score). Any engine change that lowers benchmark_score is rejected.
_meta.note: hard_constraints are auto-checkable with the same logic as benchmark/run_benchmark.dart; criteria_met and expert_stars are filled by a furniture/interior expert.
